Select a section to explore the supporting documents and recordings.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: Officer Goodale was involved in two separate incidents with Gregory Hazard. Mr. Hazard filed a complaint with the department, and Chief Paul issued an apology and stated that Officer Goodale had violated multiple department policies.

Officer Goodale had barred Mr. Hazard from the police station, but Chief Paul said that this was inappropriate and subsequently rescinded the trespass order. Details of the complaint are available in the folder below.
